summary: Full frontend E2E for Framework X Flow marketing site. Tested navigation (desktop + mobile), hero CTAs, Services page (3 detail sections, service CTAs, comparison cards including 'I am still unsure' -> /book, FAQ accordion), Book page TidyCal unconfigured fallback + contact fallback CTA, Contact form (empty invalid, invalid email, unchecked privacy blocks, valid submit -> /thank-you?source=contact and correct copy), ThankYou booking vs contact copy, 404 page CTAs, Footer legal links (/privacy, /terms), and confirmed 'Framework Xplore' string does NOT appear anywhere. All 40+ assertions passed. No functional issues found.

issues: Console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' Emits repeatedly on every route change. Non-blocking but noisy — set the Lenis wrapper (or body/html) to a non-static position to silence it.

action_items: (Optional) Fix Lenis smooth-scroll warning by giving the Lenis container element position:relative (or fixed/absolute). Purely a console warning; no user-visible impact.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx: privacy_ack error message is rendered OUTSIDE the <Field> wrapper (line 241-245) so the error id/aria linkage is inconsistent with other fields. Minor a11y polish — testid works.
TidyCalEmbed.jsx status effect only depends on [path]; if `url` or unconfigured flag changes at runtime it would not re-evaluate. Not a real issue given static config, but worth noting.
Footer 'Framework X Flow' string check: verified via grep — 'Framework Xplore' is 0 occurrences across /app/frontend/src and /app/backend. Good.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All routes and CTAs validated. If TidyCal env vars become set, re-test /book to ensure iframe loads (data-testid='tidycal-container' shows and 'tidycal-unconfigured' hides). Contact form uses Resend test inbox (delivered@resend.dev) — valid POST returns 200 and redirects to /thank-you?source=contact. Backend was NOT retested this iteration (main agent stated curl tests already pass).
